data.name: Maple Leaf Cement Factory Limited
data.description: Maple Leaf Cement Factory Limited (“the Company”) is a public company limited by shares incorporated in Pakistan on April 13, 1960 under the repealed Companies Act, 1913 (now, the Companies Act, 2017). The Company’s ordinary shares are listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited. The Company is engaged in the production and sale of cement and wall putty. The Company is a subsidiary of Kohinoor Textile Mills Limited (“the Holding Company”) which is also the ultimate parent of the Company.
